# Quader Store — Architectural Web Systems & Quantitative Trading Tools

> Official software storefront and engineering catalog by Alireza Kiani (Quader). Explore production-ready web systems, full-stack SaaS kits, and quantitative MQL5 trading engines with complete unminified source code and commercial licensing.

- Canonical Storefront: https://store.quader864.ir/

- Contact: contact@quader864.ir

## Catalog Categories

- [Software Systems & Codebases](https://store.quader864.ir/products): Full-stack SaaS starter architectures, React 19 + Node.js commerce engines, and institutional MQL5 execution tools.
- [Engineering Masterclasses](https://store.quader864.ir/courses): Deep-dive curriculum on distributed web systems, quantitative strategy architecture, and low-latency execution.
- [All-In-One Studio Bundles](https://store.quader864.ir/bundles): Discounted multi-system packages combining web boilerplates, trading engines, and masterclasses.
- [Studio Retainers & Subscriptions](https://store.quader864.ir/subscriptions): Ongoing access to every software release, security patch, and architectural consultation.
- [Engineering Journal](https://store.quader864.ir/blog): Technical articles on SaaS architecture, quantitative trading systems, and modern web engineering.
